findings.reason: Source conflict recorded: {'conflict_id': 'CH-SRC-CONFLICT-10K-OPERATOR-01', 'sources': ['SRC-CH-FOCBS-CASH', 'SRC-CH-ORD-631-052'], 'topic': 'CHF 10,000 operator wording on FOCBS page vs ordinance', 'detail': "FOCBS English page body uses 'CHF 10,000 or more' / 'equals or exceeds CHF 10,000' for inquiry and information-system registration. Ordinance Art. 3 uses 'mindestens 10 000 Franken' (at least CHF 10,000 / >=). A FOCBS page lead sentence also uses 'over 10,000 francs' shorthand. Disposition: prefer the body inquiry/registration clauses and Art. 3 'mindestens' (>=) for Hardening I candidates; do not promote a strict-exceeding (>) operator for the threshold mechanics.", 'status': 'preserved_prefer_ge', 'closure_phase': 'hardening_i', 'closed_at': '2026-09-09', 'wording_boundary': 'Use >= / CHF 10,000 or more / equals or exceeds / mindestens 10 000 Franken. Do not flatten to > CHF 10,000 for the inquiry or registration mechanics.'}
findings.required_action: Resolve via human exception review

findings.reason: Source conflict recorded: {'conflict_id': 'CH-SRC-CONFLICT-REGISTRATION-SCOPE-01', 'sources': ['SRC-CH-FOCBS-CASH', 'SRC-CH-ORD-631-052'], 'topic': 'public >=CHF10k registration narrative vs Art. 6 reporting independence', 'detail': 'FOCBS public guidance states that if cash equals or exceeds CHF 10,000, an entry is registered in the FOCBS information system. Ordinance Art. 6 Abs. 2 states that customs reporting (Meldung) to the Oberzolldirektion is permissible independent of the cash amount. Disposition: keep FOCBS public >=10k registration as a distinct public-guidance proposition; keep Art. 6 amount-independent reporting as a distinct statutory reporting permission. Do not collapse them into one threshold-only recording rule.', 'status': 'preserved_dual_surface', 'closure_phase': 'hardening_i', 'closed_at': '2026-09-09', 'wording_boundary': 'FOCBS public surface: >= CHF 10,000 information-system entry. findings.required_action: Resolve via human exception review
